name: Facet
text: Ship a live contrast checker that updates in real time as users adjust the dark theme sliders. This guarantees visibility and clarity by preventing unreadable text before submission, not after. The trade-off is added interface complexity, but it’s worth it because users see the impact of their choices instantly, making the tool more engaging and effective.

name: Pane
text: The live contrast checker trains users to ignore the problem after the first click—it’s a band-aid that masks the real issue: users won’t tolerate any friction before submission. A better alternative is a pre-submission block that forces visibility checks, but only if we pair it with a "skip for now" option to avoid drop-off. Settle this by testing both: measure user retention and error rates with each approach.
